## renv — package version locking
To lock exact package versions for reproducibility, run once from the R console
after all packages are installed and working:
```r
# renv::init()     # first time: initialise and snapshot
# renv::snapshot() # after adding/updating packages
# renv::restore()  # collaborators run this to install exact same versions
```
Do NOT run renv::init() mid-analysis — do it when the project is stable and
ready for GitHub. The renv.lock file should be committed to the repository.

library(fields)

## functions
```{r functions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
delete.na <- function(DF, n = 0) {
  DF[rowSums(is.na(DF)) <= n, ]
}

# For each point (lon, lat), return the value of the nearest non-NA raster cell.
# Used for coastal points that fall in NA cells under direct extraction.
nearest_non_na <- function(rast_layer, lon, lat) {
  all_vals <- terra::values(rast_layer)[, 1]
  all_xy   <- terra::xyFromCell(rast_layer, seq_len(terra::ncell(rast_layer)))
  as.numeric(apply(cbind(lon, lat), 1, function(p) {
    dists          <- sqrt((all_xy[, 1] - p[1])^2 + (all_xy[, 2] - p[2])^2)
    dists[is.na(all_vals)] <- NA
    all_vals[which.min(dists)]
  }))
}
```

!###############################################################################
# SECTION 1: Environmental covariates
!###############################################################################

## MSEC data
Not used for this study — set eval=FALSE.
Data source: https://shiny.sesync.org/apps/msec/
Citation: Yeager et al. (2017) Ecology 98(5):1383. https://doi.org/10.1002/ecy.1884
Download: supplement file ecy1884-sup-0002-DataS1 (NetCDF layers).
```{r MSEC, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
msec_path <- paste0(geo_file, "/MSEC/ecy1884-sup-0002-DataS1")
files  <- list.files(msec_path, pattern = "*.nc")

namess <- data.frame(files) %>%
  rename(file_name = files) %>%
  mutate(file_name = substr(as.character(file_name), 1, nchar(as.character(file_name)) - 3))

ff <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15)
f  <- files[ff]
cn <- namess$file_name[ff]

data1 <- data
for (i in seq_along(f)) {
  nam <- cn[i]
  x   <- terra::rast(paste0(msec_path, "/", f[i]))
  x   <- terra::rotate(x)
  data1$loopname <- terra::extract(x, cbind(data1[, geo_col[1]], data1[, geo_col[2]]))[, 2]
  q   <- length(names(data1))
  names(data1)[q] <- nam
}
```


## land distance
Distance to the nearest land surface, extracted from GMED (Global Marine Environment Datasets).
Data source: https://gmed.auckland.ac.nz/download.html  (layer: Land Distance)
Figshare archive: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.5937268
Citation: Basher Z, Bowden DA, Costello MJ (2018) Global Marine Environment Datasets (GMED).
  Earth System Science Data. https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2018-64
File used: GMED/Land_distance/gb_land_distance.asc (5 arc-min resolution, ASC format).
```{r land_dist}
r <- terra::rast(paste0(geo_file, "/GMED/Land_distance/gb_land_distance.asc"))

# direct extraction
data$land_distance <- terra::extract(r, cbind(data$Lon, data$Lat))[, 2]

# nearest non-NA extraction (avoids NAs for coastal points)
data$land_distance_near <- nearest_non_na(r, data$Lon, data$Lat)
```


## Bio-Oracle surface data
Surface present-day layers (2000–2014) at 5 arc-min (~9.2 km) resolution.
Data source: https://www.bio-oracle.org  →  Download  →  Present-day  →  Surface
Citation: Assis J, Tyberghein L, Bosch S, Verbruggen H, Serrão EA, De Clerck O (2018)
  Bio-ORACLE v2.0: Extending marine data layers for bioclimatic modelling.
  Global Ecology and Biogeography 27:277–284. https://doi.org/10.1111/geb.12693
Also cite original: Tyberghein et al. (2012) Global Ecology and Biogeography 21:272–281.
  https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1466-8238.2011.00656.x
Variables extracted (ff indices 33,35,22,24,27,12,15 within Surface_present folder):
  SST mean, SST range, chlorophyll-a mean, chlorophyll-a range, salinity mean,
  nitrate mean, PAR mean. Download all Surface_present .asc files and place in
  geo_file/Bio-oracle/Surface_present/. The ff index vector selects the seven
  variables above — verify indices match your downloaded file list order.
```{r oracle}
rast_path <- paste0(geo_file, "/Bio-oracle/Surface_present")
files     <- list.files(rast_path, pattern = "*.asc")

namess <- data.frame(files) %>%
  rename(file_name = files) %>%
  mutate(file_name = gsub(".asc", "", as.character(file_name)))

ff <- c(33, 35, 22, 24, 27, 12, 15)  # indices for SST mean/range, chla mean/range, salinity, nitrate, PAR
f  <- files[ff]
cn <- namess$file_name[ff]

for (i in seq_along(f)) {
  nam   <- cn[i]
  nam_n <- paste0(cn[i], "_near")
  x     <- terra::rast(paste0(rast_path, "/", f[i]))

  # direct extraction
  data$loopname <- terra::extract(x, cbind(data$Lon, data$Lat))[, 2]
  q <- length(names(data)) - 1
  names(data) <- c(names(data[, 1:q]), nam)

  # nearest non-NA extraction
  data$loopname <- nearest_non_na(x, data$Lon, data$Lat)
  q <- length(names(data)) - 1
  names(data) <- c(names(data[, 1:q]), nam_n)
}
```

# SECTION 2: Species traits (WoRMS)


## tidy species list

```{r tidy_sp}
tl <- c("Superkingdom", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order",
        "Family", "Genus", "Species")

taxa <- dat %>%
  dplyr::rename(species_observed = species) %>%
  filter(primer == "18smini" | primer == "euka02") %>%
    ## strip cluster_num (last ;-delimited field) from lineage FIRST, before any
  ## join or group_by — different primers assign different cluster numbers to the
  ## same taxon, so leaving it in prevents correct primer combination later.
  mutate(lineage = stringr::str_replace(lineage, ";[^;]*$", "")) %>%
  
  select(lineage) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(lineage)) %>%
  tidyr::separate(lineage, into = tl, sep = ";", remove = FALSE)

taxa2 <- taxa %>%
  filter(Species != "NA")
```

## WoRMS accepted names
this is now done in the reference libraries
however, left because it does´t matter and to get if species are marine

```{r worms_info}
xx  <- taxa2$Species
z   <- 50
stt <- seq(1, length(xx), by = z)

worm_info_list <- vector("list", length(stt))
for (idx in seq_along(stt)) {
  i   <- stt[idx]
  j   <- if (i == last(stt)) length(xx) else i + (z - 1)
  g   <- xx[i:j]
  gg  <- worrms::wm_records_names(name = g, fuzzy = FALSE, marine_only = FALSE)
  gg  <- Filter(Negate(is.null), gg)   # drop NULLs (names not found in WoRMS)
  worm_info_list[[idx]] <- if (length(gg) > 0) bind_rows(gg) else NULL
  print(j)
}
worm_info <- bind_rows(worm_info_list)

worm_info <- worm_info %>%
  dplyr::select(AphiaID, scientificname, valid_AphiaID, valid_name,
                kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, isMarine) %>%
  dplyr::rename(AphiaID_old    = AphiaID,
                species_ncbi   = scientificname,
                species_worrms = valid_name) %>%
  dplyr::rename(AphiaID = valid_AphiaID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(isMarine)) %>%   # prefer marine records when name has multiple hits
  dplyr::distinct(species_ncbi, .keep_all = TRUE)
```


## WoRMS attributes (body size, functional group, feeding type)
```{r worms_attr}
xx  <- worm_info$AphiaID[complete.cases(worm_info$AphiaID)]
xx  <- xx[!duplicated(xx)]
z   <- 50
stt <- seq(1, length(xx), by = z)

for (i in stt) {
  j   <- if (i == last(stt)) length(xx) else i + (z - 1)
  g   <- xx[i:j]
  gg  <- worrms::wm_attr_data_(id = g, include_inherited = TRUE)
  ggg <- bind_rows(gg)
  if (i == 1) { worm_att1 <- ggg } else { worm_att1 <- rbind(worm_att1, ggg) }
  print(j)
}
```


## tidy attributes
```{r tidy_attr}
# NOTE: WoRMS API now returns 'children' as a list of data frames rather than
# a JSON string. Replaced separate() + qdapRegex string parsing with
# purrr::map + unnest to extract unit and measure_defn from nested data frames.
worm_att1_2 <- worm_att1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    children = purrr::map(children, function(ch) {
      if (!is.data.frame(ch) || nrow(ch) == 0)
        return(data.frame(unit = NA_character_, measure_defn = NA_character_))
      data.frame(unit         = as.character(ch$measurementValue),
                 measure_defn = as.character(ch$measurementType))
    })
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(children) %>%
  dplyr::select(AphiaID, measurementType, measurementValue, measure_defn, unit,
                AphiaID_Inherited, source_id) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(AphiaID = as.numeric(AphiaID))

## body size
worm_att1_bs <- worm_att1_2 %>%
  filter(measurementType %in% c("Body size (qualitative)", "Body size")) %>%
  mutate(size_mm = -100) %>%
  mutate(size_mm = if_else(unit == "mm", as.numeric(measurementValue), size_mm)) %>%
  mutate(size_mm = if_else(unit == "µm", as.numeric(measurementValue) / 1000, size_mm)) %>%
  mutate(size_mm = if_else(unit == "cm", as.numeric(measurementValue) * 10, size_mm)) %>%
  mutate(size_mm = replace(size_mm, size_mm < 0, NA)) %>%
  select(-measurementType) %>%
  group_by(AphiaID) %>%
  summarize(max_size_mm = max(size_mm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(max_body_size_mm = max_size_mm)

## functional group (adult / larva)
worm_att1_fg <- worm_att1_2 %>%
  filter(measurementType == "Functional group") %>%
  select(AphiaID, measurementValue, unit) %>%
  mutate(unit = if_else(unit == "larva > planula", "larva_planula", unit)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 103862 & measurementValue == "benthos > macrobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 112849 & measurementValue == "benthos > meiobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 115723 & measurementValue == "benthos > meiobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 115960 & measurementValue == "benthos > meiobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 136084 & measurementValue == "benthos > macrobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 355663 & measurementValue == "plankton > mesoplankton")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 410749 & measurementValue == "benthos > meiobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 206950 & measurementValue == "plankton > mesoplankton")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 206952 & measurementValue == "plankton > mesoplankton")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 207211 & measurementValue == "plankton > mesoplankton")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 220588 & measurementValue == "benthos > macrobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 231751 & measurementValue == "benthos > macrobenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 110303 & measurementValue == "mixoplankton > Constitutive Mixoplankton")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 234031 & measurementValue == "benthos > epibenthos")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 427742 & measurementValue == "plankton > microplankton")) %>%
  filter(!(AphiaID == 663583 & measurementValue == "plankton > nanoplankton")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = measurementValue, values_fill = NA,
              values_fn = dplyr::first) %>%
  mutate(adult = if_else(complete.cases(polyp) & polyp == "benthos", polyp, adult)) %>%
  mutate(larva = if_else(complete.cases(larva_planula), larva_planula, larva)) %>%
  dplyr::select(AphiaID, adult, larva) %>%
  dplyr::rename(functional_group_adult = adult, functional_group_larva = larva)

## feeding type
worm_att1_ft <- worm_att1_2 %>%
  filter(measurementType == "Feedingtype") %>%
  filter(unit != "larva" | is.na(unit)) %>%
  dplyr::select(AphiaID, measurementValue) %>%
  dplyr::rename(feeding_type = measurementValue) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = feeding_type) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(grepl("deposit",    feeding_type), "deposit feeder",              ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(grepl("parasitic",  ft2),          "parasitic",                   ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(grepl("carnivore",  ft2),          "predator",                    ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(grepl("grazer",     ft2),          "grazer",                      ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(grepl("suspension", ft2),          "suspension or filter feeder", ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(grepl("filter",     ft2),          "suspension or filter feeder", ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(AphiaID == 413379, "grazer",                        ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(AphiaID == 207675, "suspension or filter feeder",   ft2)) %>%
  mutate(ft2 = if_else(AphiaID == 106623, "parasitic",                     ft2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(AphiaID, ft2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(feeding_type = ft2) %>%
  distinct(AphiaID, .keep_all = TRUE)

## join all traits back to worm_info
worm_info2 <- worm_info %>%
  left_join(worm_att1_bs) %>%
  left_join(worm_att1_fg) %>%
  left_join(worm_att1_ft) %>%
  dplyr::rename(AphiaID_ncbi = AphiaID_old)
## check: should have same number of rows as worm_info !!!!!
```

```{r combine}

  dplyr::rename(species_ncbi = Species) %>%
  left_join(worm_info2)
```

## clean curated traits for 4th corner analysis
Import the fully manually-curated file (additional columns added outside R)
and standardise categories for use in RLQ / fourth-corner analysis.
```{r clean_new, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
dat_raw <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  xlsxFile = paste0(dir, "Red_sea_eDNA_traits.xlsx")
)

dat1 <- dat_raw %>%
  select(lineage:Species, isMarine, AS_catagory:Planktonic.larval.form,
         tropic.reference:larvel.reference)

dat2 <- dat1 %>%
    mutate(trophic.level = if_else(
    lineage == "Eukaryota;Fungi;Ascomycota;Dothideomycetes;Pleosporales;Phaeosphaeriaceae;Ophiosphaerella;Ophiosphaerella herpotricha",
    "detritovore", trophic.level)) %>%
  mutate(trophic.level = if_else(
    lineage == "Eukaryota;Fungi;Ascomycota;Dothideomycetes;Pleosporales;Didymellaceae;Boeremia;Boeremia exigua",
    "detritovore", trophic.level)) %>% 
  mutate(trophic.level = if_else(
    trophic.level %in% c("parasite", "pathogen"),
    "parasite/pathogen", trophic.level)) %>%
  mutate(trophic.level = if_else(
    trophic.level %in% c("detritivore", "deposit feeders"),
    "detritivore/deposit feeder", trophic.level)) %>%
  mutate(zone = if_else(zone == "pelagic",    "planktonic", zone)) %>%
  mutate(zone = if_else(zone == "intertidal", "benthic",    zone)) %>%
  filter(zone != "land") %>%
  mutate(Planktonic.larval.form = if_else(
    Planktonic.larval.form == "both", "yes", Planktonic.larval.form))


```

# fix text of taxa to match new data

          "family", "genus", "species")


taxa_full <- taxa  %>%
  mutate(lineage = sub("^[^;]+;", "", lineage)) %>% 
# has ´NA´from separate, need to remove
 mutate(across(all_of(cols4), ~na_if(., "NA"))) 

# prep and add original traits to new list of species
cols <- c("lineage", "kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", 
          "family", "genus", "species")

clean <- function(x) tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

dat2 <- dat1 %>% 
  select(-superkingdom) %>% 
  full_join(
  worm_info3 ,
  by = cols
)

# add taxa without species that were removed in tidy species list names(taxa) names(dat2)
 
cols2 <- c("lineage", "kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", 
          "family", "genus", "species")
is_missing <- function(x) is.na(x) | x == ""

dat3 <- dat2 %>%  # names(dat3)
  bind_rows(taxa_full %>% anti_join(dat2, by = cols2)) %>%
  arrange(lineage) %>% 
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  # combine ismarine columns
  mutate(
    ismarine = case_when(
      is_missing(ismarine.x) & is_missing(ismarine.y) ~ NA_character_,
      ismarine.x == 1 | ismarine.y == 1 ~ "1",
      is_missing(ismarine.x) ~ as.character(ismarine.y),
      is_missing(ismarine.y) ~ as.character(ismarine.x),
      ismarine.x == ismarine.y ~ as.character(ismarine.x),
      TRUE ~ paste(ismarine.x, ismarine.y, sep = ",")
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-ismarine.x, -ismarine.y, -species_clean, -aphiaid, -aphiaid_ncbi, -superkingdom)
